what: The Hero headline pops out — the left speech-bubble tag pops from 0→1.125x, up 25%, −5° in .5s, settles into place in .5s, and then the right tag pops the opposite way at +5° with the same tempo. The letters inside the tags hop at .075s intervals from 25% below → 25% above → in place (.375s+.375s). The big letter pieces below fly in from half the headline width to the right starting after 1 second at .075s intervals (1s back.inOut), swell 0→2→1x and twist −45°→+22.5°→0 as they settle, and only the last piece (the exclamation mark) bobs once more. Meanwhile the big-letter board is squashed to .875x width and −7.5° over 1.5s after .5 seconds, then springs back with .5s back.inOut, sparkles pop out, and the description text below floats up from 1em below in 1s after 3 seconds.

options.start: If event, starts when the fx:start event arrives (fired when the loader ends). Otherwise starts right on attach
options.lag: Start time of the big text pieces (sec), default 1
options.drop: Lower position where the right tag settles (% of its own height), default 30
options.[data-fx-part=tag-left] · [data-fx-part=: Two speech-bubble tail tags — inside [data-fx-part=char] the characters hop (words are wrapped in inline-block and spaces are kept as they are)
options.[data-fx-part=bottom]: Large letter board — presses down with the bottom left as the pivot
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Large letter pieces (one letter each) — fly in one by one

note: The original sets the big text as eleven sliced images (stacked boards of the same size) and rotates each board around the text center — we use one letter span each with the same variable formula (translate (1−p1)×50% + p4×10% · scale p2+p4×.25 · rotate p3×−45° + p4×30°), measuring 50% by the heading width (--fx-copy-w)
